items.title: File Widerspruch against Grundsicherung decision
items.quote: Die Frist dafür beträgt einen Monat ab Bekanntgabe; der Widerspruch ist schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei Kreisverwaltung Beispiel-Westerwald, Peter-Altmeier-Platz 2, 56410 Musterbaur einzulegen.
items.computation: Letter dated Friday 20.11.2026, sent by regular post (presumed same day). The statutory delivery-fiction rule for an administrative letter sent by ordinary mail is § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X: deemed delivered on the THIRD day after posting (the letter itself misquotes this as the 'fourth day', see warning). Counting from 20.11.2026: day 1 = 21.11 (Sat), day 2 = 22.11 (Sun), day 3 = 23.11.2026 (Mon) — a business day, so no weekend/holiday shift applies and Bekanntgabe = 23.11.2026. Widerspruchsfrist is one month 'ab Bekanntgabe' (§ 84 SGG / § 26 SGB X with §§ 187, 188 BGB): the day of the event itself (23.11.) is not counted (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB), so the month runs from 24.11.2026 and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the triggering day, i.e. 23.12.2026 (Wednesday). 23.12.2026 is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in Rheinland-Pfalz, so no shift is needed.

warnings: The letter's own delivery-fiction clause states 'Bekannt gegeben ist ein Bescheid, den wir mit einfachem Brief schicken, am vierten Tag nach dem Versand (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X)' — but § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X actually provides for the THIRD day after posting, not the fourth; this computation uses the correct statutory third-day rule, which still lands on the same calendar date in this case, but the recipient should be aware the letter misquotes the law.
